segments.sn35.131:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā bhaggesu viharati susumāragire bhesakaḷāvane migadāye.
segments.sn35.131:1.2: Atha kho nakulapitā gahapati yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami … pe … ekamantaṃ nisinno kho nakulapitā gahapati bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn35.131:1.3: “ko nu kho, bhante, hetu, ko paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme no parinibbāyanti?
segments.sn35.131:1.4: Ko pana, bhante, hetu, ko paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme parinibbāyantī”ti?
segments.sn35.131:1.5: “Santi kho, gahapati, cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
segments.sn35.131:1.6: Tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
segments.sn35.131:1.7: Tassa taṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato tannissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ hoti tadupādānaṃ.
segments.sn35.131:1.8: Saupādāno, gahapati, bhikkhu no parinibbāyati … pe … santi kho, gahapati, jivhāviññeyyā rasā … pe … santi kho, gahapati, manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
segments.sn35.131:1.11: Tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
segments.sn35.131:1.12: Tassa taṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato tannissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ hoti tadupādānaṃ.
segments.sn35.131:1.14: Ayaṃ kho, gahapati, hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme no parinibbāyanti”.
segments.sn35.131:2.1: “Santi ca kho, gahapati, cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
segments.sn35.131:2.3: Tassa taṃ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato na tannissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ hoti, na tadupādānaṃ.
segments.sn35.131:2.4: Anupādāno, gahapati, bhikkhu parinibbāyati … pe … santi kho, gahapati, jivhāviññeyyā rasā … pe … santi kho, gahapati, manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhitā rajanīyā.
segments.sn35.131:2.7: Tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
segments.sn35.131:2.8: Tassa taṃ nābhinandato nābhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato na tannissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ hoti na tadupādānaṃ.
segments.sn35.131:2.10: Ayaṃ kho, gahapati, hetu, ayaṃ paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme parinibbāyantī”ti.
